profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Full Stack
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer with 15 years of full stack development experience. I work primarily with .NET and JavaScript. 

I also love video games, have played guitar for 20+ years, am an avid listener of music, and am happily married with a whole pile of pets.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer I
positions.description: Cognizant Softvision acquired Tin Roof Software

positions.title: IT Contractor
positions.description: Working on the Supply Chain Data Analytics team. I create new and modify existing Ab Initio processes to bring data into Teradata for the business to consume. I do impact analysis to see what processes and which users would be affected by an upcoming change in processing data. I also help investigate issues where data is missed by a process or an automated job has failed causing data to be late for business reports to consume and devise a solution. I worked on a large project where four databases were being consolidated into two. I identified all of the affected processes, notified the owners of those processes of the upcoming change, and implemented filters so that the target tables retained the same data. This ensured minimal impact to business users..
